notes: This is an independent Lit public-preview cohort and is not part of the Core/React, Mutative, tool, or Preact cohorts.
Both packages are initial 0.1.0 public previews; API and support changes require a later stability decision.
Publication must run lit before lit-ui and bind every artifact to an approved immutable main commit.
A protected Lit candidate/promotion workflow must be reviewed and added before registry dispatch; direct npm publish and dist-tag mutation are not release paths.
lit and @lit/context are peer dependencies; React is an optional peer used only by the bridge, and @lit-labs/ssr peers are optional for ./ssr.
